Metadata.Title: RHBA-2026:65128: virtio-win bug fix and enhancement update (Important)

Platforms: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support

Metadata.Description:
The virtio-win package provides paravirtualized network drivers for most Microsoft Windows operating systems. Paravirtualized drivers are virtualization-aware drivers used by fully virtualized guests running on Red Hat Enterprise Linux. Fully virtualized guests using the paravirtualized drivers gain significantly better I/O performance than fully virtualized guests running without the drivers. 

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* [virtio-win][viogpu] Reject resolutions exceeding framebuffer segment capacity [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-212015)

* Someone driver works with debug level >= 6 (debug message flood) [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-212407)

* Virtio-win may not configure guest cache mode when using virtio-blk [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-212414)

* [virtio-win] NetKVM (virtio-win 0.1.285) does not transmit USO packets correctly [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-212419)

* viosock: Validate fd_count in VIOSockSelect against overflow and empt? [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-212423)

* [Windows]Can not connect to VM via vsock after migration [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-212535)

* [virtio-win][viogpu] Provide a way to set a custom screen resolution [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-212539)

* [viogpudo] VM crashes with BSOD/black screen when setting invalid resolution values [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-212543)

* netkvm: treat temporary TX queue full as retry, not drop [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-212566)

* viosock: Fix spec compliance issues in WSP library and socket driver [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-212596)

Criterions.Comment: Red Hat Enterprise Linux must be installed
Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 is installed
virtio-win is signed with Red Hat redhatrelease2 key
